_about: Settings of RL1 (attention policy + REINFORCE with a shared baseline) for main_formulation_3. Every value can also be overridden on the command line of train_rl1.py / solve_rl1.py. Formulation data (costs, fleet, T, ...) are NOT here: they come from dataset_ev_solomon/csv and code/f3_params.json.

generator._about: Random training instances (rl1_generator.py). Fleet, stations, costs, T, depot and city area come from the CSV dataset per (file size, class); these settings only shape the new random customers.

model._about: Policy network (rl1_model.Policy): embedding size d, attention heads, encoder layers, feed-forward width, logit clipping C, hidden width of the small MLPs on the dynamic features.

training._about: First imitation_batches warm-up batches teach the policy the greedy cost rule (teacher forcing; 0 = pure RL from random weights). Then REINFORCE with a shared baseline (POMO): every instance is rolled out `samples` times, the baseline is the mean cost of its own rollouts. Training cost = Z + drop_penalty x (instance cost scale) per EV that could not be placed. lr = learning rate of the imitation warm-up (and of REINFORCE when imitation_batches = 0); lr_reinforce = learning rate of REINFORCE after a warm-up (smaller, so the noisy policy gradient does not undo the warm-up). One epoch = iters_per_epoch batches, then validation on fixed generated instances against the greedy cost rule; model_best.pt = best validation.

inference._about: solve_rl1.py: per instance, `augment` symmetric copies of the input (rotations / reflections of the map, 1..8) x (1 greedy rollout + `samples` sampled rollouts); the plan with the fewest unplaced EVs, then the lowest Z, is kept. chunk = rollouts simulated together (memory).
